d:
Recreating the magic of the 1940’s with music composed by Sneha Khanwalkar, in the voice of Shankar Mahadevan.
Official video song ‘Nagri Nagri’ from the movie Manto.
Music Composer: Sneha Khanwalkar
Singer: Shankar Mahadevan
Lyrics: Meeraji
Produced By Anjo John
Rhythm And Percussion: Anand Bhagat
Violins: Kamal Kamble
